public.rationale: Public-co frontier-tech comp in Climate & Bio-Manufacturing

data.narrative:
Maritime Fusion, a Seed-stage frontier-energy company founded by Justin Cohen and Jason Kaufmann, operates in the Climate & Energy sector alongside a comparable universe of 9 peers (1 public, 8 private), including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen. The company has raised $4.5M to date.

Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.5x multiplier to the $4.5M total raised, yielding an implied valuation of $11M. This method reflects typical step-up economics from Seed to next stage. Peer-median triangulation was not applicable due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow Climate & Energy peer set; while nine sector peers exist, none met the threshold of three or more matches within stage or valuation tier filters, making a narrowly-calibrated median unreliable.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $10M to $13M, with a median of $11M. This range is based solely on stage-progression methodology, limiting its robustness to a single method. Key uncertainties include the lack of directly comparable Seed-stage fundraising data from peers in the sector, which constrains confidence in the multiplier applied. Additional downside risk stems from typical frontier-energy execution and commercialization risk. The valuation would benefit from tighter peer comparability or revenue/metrics-based methods as Maritime Fusion progresses.
